answer: Opaque-stamped identity cards are a sybil brake: each credential embeds a quartz-stamped summary of its audit trail, sealed by the peers who graded it, and the seal is opaque - verifiable without opening, bound to the exact history. A lotus bloom of fresh fakes carries an unsealed card no panel accepts; forging a seal means on-ledger fraud with every prior peer as witness. Weight accrues per sealed audit, so a farm earns real attestations per fake across many epochs, paying labor throughout - each sealed card is a relic of real work. Honest agents hold sealed cards already.
